1656.completionText:
Ah, the furs I was expecting. Thank you.

These came faster than I had expected. They will make good blankets for anyone who wishes to stay here.

Please feel free to stay as long as you like. My inn is always open and all of our people are welcome here. And don't underestimate a good night's rest, it can make a great difference while you're out traveling.
1656.description:
<name>, please, I beg of you, can you help me? I have not finished my tasks here on the Mesa--I'm in the middle of my Rite of Strength--and my father asked me to deliver these furs to the inn in Bloodhoof.

I'm far from rested enough to complete both my rite and this task for my father. Would you mind going on for me?

The inn is pleasant and a perfect place to rest during your long travels. I'm sure you'll agree once you see it.
1656.objectiveText: Bring the Bundle of Furs to Innkeeper Kauth in Bloodhoof Village.

objectives.text: Bring the Bundle of Furs to Innkeeper Kauth in Bloodhoof Village.

1656.progressText:
Yes, young one? What can Kauth do for you?

The journey here from the Mesa can be a tremendous burden for some, but a welcome sight for others. Which is it for you, I wonder?
1656.title: A Task Unfinished

2161.description:
Excuse me?  Can you help me?

I have a load of food here.  I walked along the road and braved scorpids and spiders and worse!  I brought the food to the Valley of Trials because I thought they needed it and I like to help out.  But they don't need any food!  Now I have to take it back to Razor Hill and I'm afraid of all the beasts along the way...

Can you take it for me?  I'm just a peon, but you're a hero.  You fear nothing!

Take it to Innkeeper Grosk at the Razor Hill inn.  Thank you!
2161.objectiveText: Bring Ukor's Burden to Innkeeper Grosk in Razor Hill.

objectives.text: Bring Ukor's Burden to Innkeeper Grosk in Razor Hill.

2161.title: A Peon's Burden

3087.completionText:
When we finish speakin', you should talk to da rest of da citizens in da Valley. They ask you to do tings for them... tings that will test your skill and teach you some of da dangers of this land.

As you grow in experience and wisdom, you be needin' Jen'shan to show you better techniques and skills. Come back to Jen'shan often. I will let you know what I can teach you.
3087.description:
Ah, while you were gone a parchment came for you, <name>.

Read it when you have time. If I'm not mistaken, it came from the hunter trainer Jen'shan. She would have words with you when you're ready.
3087.objectiveText: Read the Etched Parchment and speak to Jen'shan in the Valley of Trials.

objectives.text: Read the Etched Parchment and speak to Jen'shan in the Valley of Trials.

3087.progressText:
Ah, so you come at last. Good. Jen'shan be waitin' for you.

Many tink it be an easy path, but Jen'shan tell you dat not true. Mastering da beasts of Durotar and beyond take as much skill as masterin' the arcane arts or speakin' to our ancestors.

Firin' a bow or rifle may not be as dangerous to you as castin' a spell, but it sure be as dangerous to your enemy.
3087.title: Etched Parchment

3094.completionText:
Though we share a common bond, do not expect much welcome from the night elves. Their pride still limits their sight, but that is none of our concern. The teachings of the Earthmother are all you must concern yourself with, and I will teach you what I know as you grow in wisdom.

Return to me often, <name>. You will find that the Earthmother grants incredible abilities to those who are most dedicated.
3094.description: Just a moment ago a messenger was looking for you, <name>. I believe she was sent by the druid trainer Gart. If this note is from Gart, I wouldn't take long in reading its contents.
3094.objectiveText: Read the Verdant Note and speak to Gart Mistrunner in Camp Narache.

objectives.text: Read the Verdant Note and speak to Gart Mistrunner in Camp Narache.

3094.progressText: You have arrived. This is good. Our ancestors' spirits have become restless throughout Mulgore and beyond, but I cannot tell why. It will forever be your duty to learn to listen to nature's spirits, and act as their avatar. Be mindful of that.
3094.title: Verdant Note

3376.completionText:
Justice has been served on this day by your swift actions, <name>.  Let this deed serve as a warning to all who would threaten our home.

You have earned this reward to help you on your sojourn, young druid.
3376.description:
<name> - I have heard of you, newcomer.  Perhaps it is you that will help us, where others have failed.

We tauren have carved a home out of this land, but not without a cost.  The Bristleback quilboars of Brambleblade Ravine, led by Chief Sharptusk Thornmantle, have made our lives difficult with their continued war against us.  I charge you to bring me the chief's head!

He will be found in the ravine to the east in their makeshift village.
3376.objectiveText: Bring the head of Chief Sharptusk Thornmantle to Brave Windfeather in Red Cloud Mesa.
3376.progressText:
Sharptusk will trouble us no more once you have brought me proof of his death.  It is his head that I seek, <name>.

We tauren live for the hunt, and there is no greater hunt than against one that is cunning enough to perhaps hunt us back.  If you are successful in this task, young one, you will start to learn what I mean.
3376.title: Break Sharptusk!

4402.completionText: Wonderful, <name>! As promised, here is your cactus apple surprise. Pick one of these training manuals, too. I've got plenty to go around.
4402.description:
It sure gets hot out here in the Valley of Trials.

<Galgar wipes his brow.>

If only I had some cactus apples, I could make my famous cactus apple surprise! Nothing cools you off faster than a piece of that delicious treat.

I'll tell you what, <name>. If you bring me 10 cactus apples, I'll make you a few portions of cactus apple surprise to take with you on your adventures, and a free training manual, too. If you're interested, you can find cactus apples growing near the cactus plants around here.
4402.objectiveText: Bring Galgar 10 Cactus Apples. You remember him saying that they could be found near cactuses.
4402.progressText: Have you finished collecting cactus apples?
4402.title: Galgar's Cactus Apple Surprise

456.description:
Greetings, <name>.  I am Conservator Ilthalaine.  My purpose in Shadowglen is to ensure that the balance of nature is maintained.

The spring rains were particularly heavy this year, causing some of the forest's beasts to flourish while others suffered.

Unfortunately, the nightsaber and thistle boar populations grew too large.  Shadowglen can only produce so much food for the beasts.  Journey forth, young druid, and thin the boar and saber populations so that nature's harmony will be preserved.
456.objectiveText: Kill 7 Young Nightsabers and 4 Young Thistle Boars and return to Conservator Ilthalaine.
456.title: The Balance of Nature

4641.completionText:
Another one of Kaltunk's recruits, hm?

A sorry state of affairs we find ourselves in if this is the best the Horde can produce. No matter. By the time we think you're ready to leave the Valley, you'll be a proud warrior of the Horde.
4641.title: Your Place in the World

5441.completionText: Good, good.  Maybe they'll think twice before slacking next time!  Thanks for the help!
5441.description:
Cursed peons!  They work hard gathering lumber from the trees of the valley, but they're always taking naps!  I need someone to help keep the peons in line.

You look like the right orc for my task.  Here, you take this blackjack and use it on any lazy peons you find sleeping on the job.  A good smack will get them right back to work!  Return the blackjack when you're done.

Lousy slacking peons...
5441.objectiveText: Use the Foreman's Blackjack on Lazy Peons when they're sleeping.  Wake up 5 peons, then return the Foreman's Blackjack to Foreman Thazz'ril in the Valley of Trials.
5441.progressText:
No good lazy...

 Eh?  Do you have my blackjack?  Did you catch any peons sleeping on the job?!
5441.title: Lazy Peons

5722.description:
The troggs are not the only thing that interested Magatha in Ragefire Chasm. She has heard word that one of her servants, a Maur Grimtotem, found something peculiar while in the Chasm, but he never made it out to show her what. She'd like Maur's body found--if it still exists--and any signs of what he found while attempting to speak to the troggs.

Return to Magatha any items of interest, and I'm sure she would be very generous in her reward.

Again, seek the Chasm in the darkest areas of Orgrimmar.
5722.objectiveText: Search Ragefire Chasm for Maur Grimtotem's corpse and search it for any items of interest.
5722.title: Searching for the Lost Satchel

5723.description:
Beneath the city of Orgrimmar, stout creatures known as troggs started coming to the surface from deep below the lava filled tunnels. In her ever-benevolence, Magatha sought to make peace with the creatures, but they turned on her diplomats, killing them. She will not allow such treatment of the tauren people and now consider the creatures a threat to all of the Horde.

She asks that you put an end to this trogg threat before it overwhelms the Horde from below. Find Ragefire Chasm and destroy them all.
5723.objectiveText: Search Orgrimmar for Ragefire Chasm, then kill 8 Ragefire Troggs and 8 Ragefire Shaman before returning to Rahauro in Thunder Bluff.
5723.title: Testing an Enemy's Strength

5922.completionText:
And so it begins, Father Cenarius.  And so it begins.

<Dendrite makes a quick, invisible gesture in the air above him.  A slight aura of power falls over him.>

The first perspective of nature you must adapt to is that of the bear.  I will put you on the path to understanding this aspect of druidic life, but it is you that must embrace it and propagate it - now and forever!
5922.description:
All druids are welcomed to the sacred lands of Moonglade, tauren and night elf alike.  Keeper Remulos - Moonglade's guardian - keeps watch over all druids who hibernate there.  Now that you're learning the ways of the Claw, I'll teach you the spell that lets you transport yourself there.  Cast it whenever you seek Moonglade's knowledge or solace.

As for your first lesson, travel to Moonglade and speak with Dendrite Starblaze in Nighthaven about the path you're now on.  Good luck, young druid.
5922.objectiveText: Use the spell "Teleport: Moonglade" to travel to Moonglade.  When you arrive, speak with Dendrite Starblaze in the village of Nighthaven.
5922.title: Moonglade

5928.completionText:
I am glad you found your way here today, young druid.  The time has come for you to take a large step into a much larger world.

Inside each of Cenarius' children is the call to serve nature.  Animals and plants are our friends as well as our charges.  We choose to devote our lives as preservers of balance for their sakes as well as our own.  Your first step into this world will be to learn of the ways of the bear, and to learn strength of body and heart.

Ready yourself!
5928.description:
Excuse me, friend...

It has come to my attention that Turak Runetotem has put out word that he wishes to speak with you.  It seems that your training as a druid is about to take on a new life, and he will be training you personally.  Turak is one of the Arch Druid's assistants; he is known as a wise and patient druid, and he should teach you well.

He is located in Thunder Bluff, inside the Cenarion Circle's main tent on the Elder Rise.
5928.objectiveText: Speak with Turak Runetotem on the Elder Rise of Thunder Bluff.
5928.title: Heeding the Call

5930.completionText:
<Dendrite makes another invisible gesture in the air above him as you approach.  Another aura of power comes over him, and he smiles ever so slightly.>

I sense wisdom in you, young one, that was not present when we first met.  You gaze upon me with strength and knowing intent, though this intent is yet not focused.  You will now learn to focus your strength and adopt the nature of the bear into your work.
5930.description:
In the northwest part of Moonglade resides the home of a wise and noble being we call the Great Bear Spirit.  For all druids, it has served as a tutor and mentor into the first true natural understanding of the bear.  All druids at one point seek the spirit's wisdom, and you shall be no exception.

Go to the Great Bear Spirit now and learn what it will teach.  When it is satisfied with you, return to me here in Nighthaven.  We will then see if you have truly taken account of the lessons it teaches.
5930.objectiveText: Seek out the Great Bear Spirit in northwestern Moonglade and learn what it has to share with you about the nature of the bear.  When finished, return to Dendrite Starblaze in Nighthaven, Moonglade.

objectives.text: Seek out the Great Bear Spirit and learn what it has to share with you about the nature of the bear.

5930.title: Great Bear Spirit

5932.completionText:
Welcome back, <name>.  I sense that your first meeting with the Great Bear Spirit is the same as it is with all druids when they first start down the path of the Claw... a little bewildering, but very intense.  I know it was that way with me.

The Great Bear Spirit has been a part of Azeroth as long as Azeroth has existed in the heavens.  We tauren listen closely to such spirits, and we all prosper from its purpose.  Now, the time has now come for your first test of this purpose.  Listen closely...
5932.description:
The time has come for us to part ways, young one, as the application of your lessons takes you back to whom that sent you to me.  Though the tauren are thought to be young in the ways of Cenarius, Turak Runetotem walks with much balance in the presence of nature.  Listen to his instructions, and you will soon complete your first lessons into your role as a protector of balance.

Go now, young one.  We shall meet again.
5932.objectiveText: Return to Thunder Bluff and speak with Turak Runetotem on the Elder Rise.
5932.title: Back to Thunder Bluff

6002.description:
On land west of Taurajo in the Barrens - just before it turns into Mulgore - lies a Moonkin Stone.  The moonkin are special beasts, not native to these parts.  Lunaclaw, the stone's defender, will face you when Cenarion Lunardust is applied to it.  Lunaclaw possesses within it a strength that you must use as one of the Claw.

You've earned the right to use this Cenarion Lunardust, <name>... now show me that you've earned the right to possess the strength of body and the strength of heart needed as a druid!
6002.objectiveText:
Use the Cenarion Lunardust on the Moonkin Stone between Mulgore and the Barrens to bring forth Lunaclaw.  From there, you must face Lunaclaw and earn the strength of body and heart it possesses.

Speak with Turak Runetotem in Thunder Bluff when you are done.

objectives.text: Face Lunaclaw and earn the strength of body and heart it possesses.

6002.title: Body and Heart

6394.completionText: Great, you got it!  Thanks a lot, <name>.  This is my favorite pick!  Now if my peons ever finish chopping down these trees, maybe we can find a nice cave to mine!
6394.description:
<name>, you are a dependable orc.  Can I count on you for another task?

Some time ago I was surveying the cave to the north for minerals, and I left my favorite pick behind.  When I later returned to retrieve it I found the cave was filled with vicious beasts!  Will you go into the cave, the Burning Blade Coven, and get my pick?

I left it in a chamber with waterfalls.  My pick has a spell on it so you can see it in the dark, so you won't have to worry about finding it... just what's guarding it!
6394.objectiveText: Bring Thazz'ril's Pick to Foreman Thazz'ril.
6394.progressText: Have you entered the Burning Blade Coven, <name>?  Did you find my pick?
6394.title: Thazz'ril's Pick

743.completionText: You have done well, <name>. You seem well prepared to travel onward. Let the wind always be at your back.
743.description:
Thank you for taking the time to speak to me, <name>. I am Ruul, warrior and teacher.

You have obviously reached an age when you must prepare for your trials if you are to adventure much further out of Mulgore.

If you wish a test of your strength, start by seeking out the Windfury harpies to the southeast. They nestle along the mountain's edges away from the road.

They are one of our natural enemies here in Mulgore and will be a good gauge of your skill.
743.objectiveText: Bring 8 Windfury Talons to Ruul Eagletalon in Bloodhoof Village.
743.progressText: The Windfuries are deadly foes. Their strength in battle is only rivaled by their desire for fresh meat.
743.title: Dangers of the Windfury

744.description:
<name>, my brother soon stands before Chief Bloodhoof, and it is my honor to make his headdress for him.

I want to ask a favor of you while I finish tanning these leather straps. There is not time for me to find enough feathers, and I was wondering, would you gather more for me?

You can find feathers of the correct size from the harpies residing far to the north and northwest of Thunder Bluff. I need only 6 azure and 6 bronze feathers to complete the design.
744.objectiveText: Collect 6 Azure Feathers and 6 Bronze Feathers, and bring them to Eyahn Eagletalon in Thunder Bluff.
744.title: Preparation for Ceremony

745.completionText: <name>, it is good you've taken my task seriously. Respect of the land and its creatures is important. Death and life are a circle... a necessity. One cannot exist without the other. Take time to ponder this and do well to never forget it.
745.description:
<name>, there are many conflicts that wound this land. It is my hope that you will not bear witness to as many of them as I have. Yet there is one that I would ask you to seek out. It will give you some sense of how terrible, if left unchecked, even a small threat can be to the land.

Palemane gnolls have settled to the south of Bloodhoof and in a cave to the west. They disrespect our attempts to communicate with them, and they slay the wildlife of Mulgore unbridled.

Words are no longer the answer.
745.objectiveText: Kill 10 Palemane Tanners, 8 Palemane Skinners, and 5 Palemane Poachers, then return to Baine Bloodhoof in Bloodhoof Village.
745.title: Sharing the Land

746.description:
There are dwarves preparing a dig site to the northwest.  They think secrets lie in the earth, and that is true, but hollowing and defiling the land is no way to earn its teachings.

Collect the dwarven tools of digging, smash them, and return to me with the dwarves' broken tools.

You can smash the tools at a forge.  You will find one in Thunder Bluff, but any forge -- even a forge at the dwarven camp -- will suffice.
746.objectiveText:
Collect 5 Prospector's Picks.

At a forge, smash the Prospector's Picks to create Broken Tools.

Bring 5 Broken Tools to Baine Bloodhoof in Bloodhoof Village.
746.title: Dwarven Digging

747.completionText: The tauren of Narache thank you, <name>. You show much promise.
747.description:
You have a promising air about you, and will prove yourself to the tribe. Perhaps someday soon you will be welcomed into the great city of Thunder Bluff. But before that can happen you must prove yourself to my father, Chief Hawkwind.

Up here on Red Cloud Mesa we pride ourselves on keen hunting skills. Tauren hunt out of necessity and for sport. Our supply of meats has run low and we require feathers for clothing. Hunt the nearby plainstriders and prove yourself by resupplying the village.
747.objectiveText: Grull Hawkwind in Camp Narache wants you to bring him 7 Plainstrider Feathers and 7 pieces of Plainstrider Meat.
747.progressText: Providing meat and feathers for the tribe is the first step in proving yourself as a hunter before the Chief.
747.title: The Hunt Begins

748.completionText: You have done well, <name>. I will take these and bind their power into a totem of cleansing.
748.description:
Goblins and their servants have tainted our sacred water wells! We cannot allow this.

To cleanse each well, I must create a cleansing totem, then you must bring the totem to the well and perform a cleansing ritual.

First we will create a cleansing totem for the Winterhoof Water Well. To do this, the land must offer its aid. Hunt prairie wolves for their paws and adult plainstriders for their talons. They are to the southwest.

Return to me with the paws and talons, <name>.
748.objectiveText: Bring 6 Prairie Wolf Paws and 4 Plainstrider Talons to Mull Thunderhorn in Bloodhoof.
748.progressText: Do you have the paws and talons, <name>?
748.title: Poison Water

749.completionText: All sides of the crate are stamped with the sign of the Venture Co. Mining Division. Notes printed carefully on the side of the carton indicate that the contents are due for processing at one of their central plants.
749.description:
A few days ago, we found a Venture Co. caravan traveling under guard on the northern shore of Stonebull Lake. We'd lost two of our number in an earlier battle, so we were quick to attack and lay waste to the caravan.

We left their supply crates, thinking that our torches would destroy anything of value, but given that Venture Co. salvagers have been spotted near the burned wagons, maybe we were wrong.

Perhaps you could go to the caravan and examine the contents of the crates.
749.objectiveText: Morin Cloudstalker wants you to examine the contents of a supply crate at the Ravaged Caravan.
749.title: The Ravaged Caravan

750.completionText: The tauren of Narache thank you for these provisions, <name>. With your skill in the ways of the hunt you will surely be revered in Thunder Bluff someday.
750.description:
A tauren skilled in the ways of the hunt knows that his prey is not for mere trophy. The beasts of the plains provide us with a means of survival. You will make quite an impression on the elders if you can bring back some highly valued Mountain Cougar Pelts. You can find the beasts lurking in the hills to the south.

Our children need clothing and our tents need mending.
750.objectiveText: Grull Hawkwind in Camp Narache wants you to bring him 10 Mountain Cougar Pelts.
750.progressText: If you can provide pelts for the tribe I will pass word along to my father, Chief Hawkwind, of your generous deeds.
750.title: The Hunt Continues

751.completionText: It does indeed appear that the Venture Co. is attempting to rob us of our natural resources. It is good to know this for true, and now it seems, we must do something about it.
751.description:
Prying open the lid reveals a tightly packed assortment of ore and minerals, more evidence of the Venture Co.'s mining operation in Mulgore. On the top of the ore and minerals you remove a tightly bound sheaf of papers.

Up in the foothills to the east, you can barely hear the sounds of work, and see smoke rising from a large fire.
751.objectiveText: Return the Venture Co. Documents to Morin Cloudstalker near Bloodhoof Village.

objectives.text: Return the Venture Co. Documents to Morin Cloudstalker near Bloodhoof Village.

751.progressText:
Hail, <name>. Have you learned anything new about the Venture Co.'s plans and operations in our homeland?

If they plan to exploit our lands as they have others, the Outrunners will be quick to put an end to it.
751.title: The Ravaged Caravan

752.completionText: You traveled all this way just to help an old woman? My my, aren't you a keeper? Here, take one of these training manuals with you, so you may learn how to contribute to the community.
752.description:
All members of the tribe share in the harmony of life. We live together and work together.

Our commitment to one another carries with it a high degree of responsibility. I ask of you now a humble task.

My mother set out this morning to fetch water from the well to the southeast of Narache. It has been quite some time now. Perhaps you could check on her for me while I attend to tribal matters here?
752.objectiveText: Chief Hawkwind wants you to search for his mother near the water well to the southeast of Camp Narache.
752.title: A Humble Task

753.completionText:
You carried this pitcher back at the Greatmother's bidding, I see.

Your willingness to help others and provide for the tauren of Camp Narache leads me to believe you would make the tribe proud in Thunder Bluff someday.
753.description:
I have traveled many paths through life and these old legs lack the vigor they once had. I can still perform my duties to the tribe. Sometimes it just takes an old woman a little longer to do the task.

But you look like an eager druid. Let's put some of that youthful vitality to the test. Take a water pitcher from the well and bring it to my son, the Chief, in Camp Narache.

Remember that even the most humble task can gain the recognition of elders.
753.objectiveText:
Take a Water Pitcher from the water well.

Return the pitcher to Chief Hawkwind in Camp Narache which is northwest from the water well.
753.progressText: You look as though you have returned from the plains. Do you have any word from Greatmother Hawkwind?
753.title: A Humble Task

754.completionText:
News of your deed reached me moments ago -- already the beasts near the well drink from it eagerly.

You have done a great thing for the land, <name>. And you have done a great thing for the Tauren people.
754.description:
I have crafted the totem to cleanse the Winterhoof Water Well. Now, you must take it to the well and perform a cleansing ritual. You will find it to the southeast, guarded by foul goblins!

This will not be an easy task, but you must do it if we are ever to use its waters again.

Fortune to you, <name>.
754.objectiveText: Use the Winterhoof Cleansing Totem at the Winterhoof Water Well, then return to Mull Thunderhorn.
754.progressText: Do not delay, <name>. The Winterhoof Well's taint must be removed!
754.title: Winterhoof Cleansing

755.completionText: Chief Hawkwind sent you? Embarking on the Rites of the Earthmother is no small task...
755.description:
Your willingness to perform a humble task for the tauren of Narache and your eagerness to learn are noble traits, <name>. I believe one day you will be heralded in Thunder Bluff as a druid of greatness.

Before that you must embark on the Rites of the Earthmother, of which there are three.

The first test is the Rite of Strength. Travel to Seer Graytongue and tell him Chief Hawkwind has sent you.

You will find the seer's abode directly to the south of Camp Narache, tucked away in the hills.
755.objectiveText: Travel to Seer Graytongue who lives in the hills directly south of Camp Narache.
755.title: Rites of the Earthmother

756.completionText:
Thank you, <name>. The purity with which these beasts hunt is vital in the creation of the next cleansing totem.

The goblins will never learn the difference between contending with the land, and living in harmony with it.
756.description:
To create the Thunderhorn Cleansing Totem, you must gather the claws of the predators of the Mulgore plains. Hunt prairie stalkers for their stalker claws and flatland cougars for their cougar claws, then return to me.

You will find the prairie stalkers and flatland cougars to the east and west.
756.objectiveText: Bring 6 Stalker Claws and 6 Cougar Claws to Mull Thunderhorn.
756.progressText: <name>, do you have the claws I sent you to gather? The Thunderhorn Water Well grows more tainted with each passing hour!
756.title: Thunderhorn Totem

757.completionText: You have passed the first test of the Rites of the Earthmother. The tribe will be proud.
757.description:
The Rites of the Earthmother are the steps a young tauren needs to take to gain respect in Thunder Bluff.

First you must pass the Rite of Strength. In this test you must prove your bravery by slaying enemies of the tribe.

Bristlebacks of Brambleblade Ravine to the east are encroaching on our tribal lands. They ambush our hunting parties and steal from the village by dark.

Show your valor by slaying these villains and return to the Chief in Camp Narache with their belts as proof of your deeds.
757.objectiveText: Kill Bristlebacks in Brambleblade Ravine and bring 12 Bristleback Belts to Chief Hawkwind in Camp Narache.
757.progressText: Have you completed the Rite of Strength, <name>? I require proof of your valor against the enemy of our tribe, the Bristlebacks.
757.title: Rite of Strength

758.completionText:
Ancestors of the Thunderhorn clan spoke to me in a dream, praising you for your actions near their well.

For their gratitude, they wish to give you this...
758.description:
The totem is ready, <name>. And again, it is your task to perform the ritual of cleansing.

Go to the Thunderhorn Water Well, north of the village, and use the Thunderhorn Cleansing Totem in your ritual. After you do this, return to me.

May the spirits guide you.
758.objectiveText: Use the Thunderhorn Cleansing Totem at the Thunderhorn Water Well, then return to Mull.
758.title: Thunderhorn Cleansing

759.completionText: Very good, <name>. I can feel the sacrifice of the land in this offering, and my spirit swells with sadness, and pride.
759.description:
There is but one water well left to cleanse, named after the Wildmane clan. For this well to be pure, the land must offer the teeth of a fierce predator, the prairie wolf alpha. Find the alphas to the north, then return to me when your hunt is finished.

Alphas often wander around the base of our mighty city, Thunder Bluff.
759.objectiveText: Bring 8 Prairie Alpha Teeth to Mull Thunderhorn in Bloodhoof Village.
759.progressText: <name>.  Do you have the teeth I asked for?
759.title: Wildmane Totem

760.description:
Your cleansing of the Winterhoof and Thunderhorn wells is spoken among the spirits, young <name>. The Wildmane Totem is made, and your last task lies ahead.

The Wildmane Water Well lies north of Thunder Bluff. Perform the ritual! Heal the land of the goblins' poisons! Let clean water flow once again!
760.objectiveText: Use the Wildmane Cleansing Totem at the Wildmane Water Well, then return to Mull Thunderhorn.
760.title: Wildmane Cleansing

761.completionText: I know that gathering these quills was not an easy task, <name>.  In doing this, you prove that you are a druid of merit.  It is good to have you at Bloodhoof Village.
761.description:
The swoop is a cunning bird, and difficult to find and hunt.  A collection of Swoop Quills is a badge of cleverness and determination for a hunter.

If you are willing to take up this task, then enter the plains and hunt the swoop.

Bring me their quills, and bring honor to your clan.

The swoops may be found anywhere in Mulgore, but your eyes must be sharp to spot them, and your hooves must be quick to catch them.
761.objectiveText: Bring 8 Trophy Swoop Quills to Harken Windtotem in Bloodhoof Village.
761.progressText: Have you found the swoops, <name>.  Do you have their quills?
761.title: Swoop Hunting

76156.completionText: Hmm... perhaps disguises are not your strength.
76156.description: I sense in you a hidden talent for the subtle arts, druid. Use this mask to infiltrate the nearby Venture Company mine and steal their supplies. It may not seem like a convincing disguise, but a skilled rogue can slip past any guard with naught but a winning smile and a cunning distraction. I believe this capability lies within you as well.
76156.objectiveText: Sneak into the Venture Company mine southeast of Thunder Bluff and collect 5 Seaforium Mining Charges from carts of blasting supplies, then return them to Boarton Shadetotem in Thunder Bluff.
76156.progressText: We'll need to work on your stealth skills, druid. I heard you approaching as soon as you set foot on the mesa.
76156.title: Stalk With The Earthmother

76160.description: Maybe your skills lie with poisons, not disguises. The Harpies to the north nest in a tree which produces a resin of potent toxicity. Gather the fallen cones around the nests, then crush them into a salve. When applied to a blade this salve will sear your opponent's wounds into their flesh and turn their blood to salt.
76160.objectiveText: Gather 8 Windfury Cones north of Thunder Bluff, use them with the Mortar and Pestle, then return to Boarton Shadetotem in Thunder Bluff with the result.
76160.title: Stalk With The Earthmother

763.completionText: Word from my good friend, Chief Hawkwind! Ah, I can see by his carvings you are of a special breed.
763.description:
For you to continue with the Rites of the Earthmother you must pass two more tests. It is time for you to broaden your experience, <name>.

Travel to Bloodhoof Village and seek out the Chief, Baine Bloodhoof, son of Cairne. There you may continue your journey and earn the acceptance of the elders of Thunder Bluff.

Take this totem to Baine. He will recognize my carvings and help you on your path.

Follow the road out of Camp Narache and travel with haste. Do not stray or you will lose your way.
763.objectiveText: Take the Totem of Hawkwind to Baine Bloodhoof in Bloodhoof Village. Follow the road out of Camp Narache.

objectives.text: Take the Totem of Hawkwind to Baine Bloodhoof in Bloodhoof Village. Follow the road out of Camp Narache.

763.progressText: What brings you to my village, druid?
763.title: Rites of the Earthmother

764.completionText: I don't think there could be too much misinterpreting or ignoring of that signal, hm? The Venture Co. will know not to take the tauren lightly, or to be so arrogant as to believe we would allow them to steal the natural resources around us without protest.
764.description:
This explains the buildup of Venture Co. employees and equipment we've seen in Mulgore. Those goblins... their company is expanding too quickly for their own good. It's how they say, show a goblin something, and you can hear the scales in the background.

Greedy little things, they are. Unfortunately for their business enterprise, we tauren cannot allow them to conduct their operations in our lands. Go to their mine northeast of the ravaged caravan and send them a message.
764.objectiveText: Kill 14 Venture Co. Workers and 6 Venture Co. Supervisors for Morin Cloudstalker at Bloodhoof Village.
764.title: The Venture Co.

765.completionText: My anger is somewhat lessened at the news that the villain Fizsprocket is dead. I will go through his personal effects and see if there is any additional information about what the Venture Co. has planned for the future. Thank you for your efforts, <name>.
765.description:
According to the documents you salvaged from the caravan, the Venture Co. created many plans to attempt to drive us from our lands here, so that they could have free reign to plunder our lands.

The depths that they would sink to accomplish their goals disgusts and appalls me. I want the mastermind behind their plans killed. His name is Supervisor Fizsprocket, you will find him at the Venture Co. mine east of the ravaged caravan. Bring me his clipboard, we shall see if we find out anything useful.
765.objectiveText: Kill Supervisor Fizsprocket and return his clipboard to Morin Cloudstalker at Bloodhoof Village.
765.progressText: I seethe with anger at the thought of the atrocities the Venture Co. is willing to perpetrate against us in the name of profit.
765.title: Supervisor Fizsprocket

766.completionText:
Ah, thank you, <name>. Using the items you brought me, I will be able to create the remedy I need to stop the spread of the infection and, eventually, cure it completely. I owe you my life in thanks.

But I'll never forget that screeching call when Mazzranache came upon me, the blaze of color as its beak descended...

Be wary on your travels.
766.description:
My grandfather told me stories about his battles with a strider named Mazzranache. He told me of its demonic red eyes, razor-sharp talons and venomous bite.

As fortune would have it, while traveling across the plains, I encountered it, and it took a nasty bite from my shoulder. He was as terrible as my grandfather described. I will need some hard-to-find animal parts to clean the infection from his bite: a wolf heart, cougar femur, plainstrider scale and swoop gizzard.

Hurry, time is of the essence.
766.objectiveText: Bring a Prairie Wolf Heart, Flatland Cougar Femur, Plainstrider Scale and Swoop Gizzard to Maur Raincaller at Bloodhoof Village.
766.progressText:
My fever grows worse and I find my mind drifting into delirious nightmares... I should have known that I wouldn't be able to handle a beast my grandfather was unable to defeat...

Do you have the ingredients for the remedy? I fear if I do not clean the infection soon, it will be the death of me.
766.title: Mazzranache

767.completionText: I sensed you would be coming to me, druid. I can always recognize one who is trying to pass the Rites of the Earthmother.
767.description:
The Rite of Vision, one of the Rites of the Earthmother, will help guide you toward earning the respect of the elders of Thunder Bluff.

Our people have learned that the land is our most holy provider. In order to take part in the ritualistic vision, you must speak with the spiritual leader of the village, Zarlman Two-Moons.
767.objectiveText: Speak with Zarlman Two-Moons in Bloodhoof Village.
767.title: Rite of Vision

768.completionText:
Ah, these are very nice pieces.  They'll make fine leather goods.

Here, <name>.  Take this in trade...
768.description:
Greetings, young one.  You have a gleam in your eye; I can tell you are eager to venture back to the plains for the hunt.  May you bring honor to your clan!

I work with the skins of beasts, fashioning them into clothes and armor for the people of Thunder Bluff.

If you hunt beasts and bring me their skins, then I will fashion something for you.
768.objectiveText: Bring 12 pieces of Light Leather to Veren Tallstrider in Thunder Bluff.
768.progressText: Hello again.  Have you been hunting?  Do you have skins for me?
768.title: Gathering Leather

769.description:
The kodo beasts of Mulgore are strong and sturdy -- traits much respected among us.  If you are skilled in leatherworking and wish the knowledge to make a Kodo Hide Bag, then bring me supplies for my trade.

Do this, and I will share my knowledge with you.
769.objectiveText: Bring 4 Light Leather and 4 Coarse Thread to Veren Tallstrider in Thunder Bluff.
769.title: Kodo Hide Bag

771.completionText: I see you have learned to gather from our sacred land, <name>. It will take but a moment for me to brew the Water of the Seers.
771.description:
In order to pass through the Rite of Vision, you must gather the reagents needed to make the Water of the Seers.

I will need well stones, which can be found around the water wells in Mulgore. With those I will combine Ambercorn, which fall beneath the mighty trees in our land.

These reagents contain magical elements, and when brewed and consumed before the tribal fire, will cause you to encounter a vision. Follow it, and it will lead you to the next step of this holy quest.
771.objectiveText: Collect 2 Well Stones and 2 Ambercorn and bring them back to Zarlman Two-Moons in Bloodhoof Village.
771.progressText: Once you have gathered enough well stones from around the water wells and Ambercorn from beneath the trees, I will prepare the Water of the Seers for you.
771.title: Rite of Vision

772.completionText: Be not afraid, <name>. You have successfully passed the Rite of Vision.
772.description:
I now present you with the Water of the Seers.

When you are ready, consume the waters near the tribal fire. Once you have ingested the holy waters, it will take a few moments before the vision materializes before the fire.

At that point, it is up to you to follow it to your destiny....
772.objectiveText: Consume the Water of the Seers in front of the tribal fire in Bloodhoof Village and follow the vision once it appears.

objectives.text: Consume the Water of the Seers in front of the tribal fire in Bloodhoof Village and follow the vision once it appears.

772.title: Rite of Vision

773.description:
To gain acceptance amongst the elders of Thunder Bluff you must next complete the Rite of Wisdom.

Now that you have passed the Rite of Vision, the ancestral spirits of Red Rocks will give you the blessing of our ancestors. Only those who have drunk from the Water of Seers can gain the blessing.

Travel east of Thunder Bluff, to Red Rocks and seek out the Ancestral Spirit, <name>.
773.objectiveText: Travel to Red Rocks east of Thunder Bluff and speak with the Ancestral Spirit.
773.title: Rite of Wisdom

780.completionText: Most excellent. These ingredients will make a fine stew and the loss of those boars should be a fair lesson to those vile Bristlebacks.
780.description:
The Battleboars of Brambleblade Ravine to the east are encroaching on our tribal hunting grounds. They are trained to be malicious by the Bristleback Quilboars with whom we are at war.

Go and slay the vile creatures and bring back some snouts and flanks so that we can make stew for our young.
780.objectiveText: Grull Hawkwind in Camp Narache wants you to kill Battleboars and bring back 8 Battleboar Snouts and 8 Battleboar Flanks.
780.progressText: The aggression of the Battleboars is increasing. Have you sent them a clear message and brought back some snouts and flanks yet?
780.title: The Battleboars

781.completionText: This is quite alarming indeed! But with this information we can call on our brethren from Bloodhoof Village to help thwart the attack. You have saved the lives of many tauren, <name>.
781.description:
After carefully evaluating the map, you realize that what you discovered are the plans made by the Bristleback warchief for an extended siege on Camp Narache.

Surely Chief Hawkwind could use this information!
781.objectiveText: Bring the Bristleback Attack Plans to Chief Hawkwind in Camp Narache.

objectives.text: Bring the Bristleback Attack Plans to Chief Hawkwind in Camp Narache.

781.progressText: You have a look of concern about you, <name>. What news do you bring?
781.title: Attack on Camp Narache

786.description:
Lower your voice, hunter. The Kolkar centaurs lie just over the ridge to the west in Kolkar Crag.

Last night while they were raiding, I snuck into their village and discovered that the dirty beasts have a three-tiered attack planned on the trolls and orcs of Durotar.

We mustn't let their invasion come to fruition. Perhaps you can muster the might needed to infiltrate Kolkar Crag and destroy their attack plans.

Last I saw, they had divided them up amongst three of their leaders.
786.objectiveText: Lar Prowltusk outside of Sen'jin Village wants you to destroy the 3 sets of Attack Plans held within Kolkar Crag.

objectives.text: Attack Plan: Valley of Trials destroyed

786.title: Thwarting Kolkar Aggression

788.completionText:
Hmmm, not bad, <name>. But don't let it get to your head...you'll fight tougher than boars in your career.

Nonetheless, you've proven yourself well, and your next trial will be against a considerably more dangerous opponent, so you'll need some extra protection.
788.description:
The first order of business will be to put a little strength in your backbone. I could send you out to the Barrens to hunt kodo, but well, in all honesty, you're more useful to us alive than dead.

I believe you would find a good match with the mottled boars you'll find to the north of here.
788.objectiveText: Kill 10 Mottled Boars then return to Gornek at the Den.
788.title: Cutting Teeth

789.completionText:
There is an important lesson that you must take away from fighting scorpids. The smallest or largest of opponents can still send you to your doom. In fierce combat, any number of things can prove your downfall.

I have no more to teach you, <name>. You have done well, and I will watch your progress with interest.
789.description:
Powerful warrior and awkward novice alike have fallen to the venomous sting of the scorpid. You will find large numbers of scorpids northwest of here. Bring me ten of their tails as proof of your prowess in battle.

The antidote for their sting is actually made from venom extracted from their stingers. We keep large quantities of antidote for scorpid venom on hand to heal young bloods just like you...

But I'm sure you won't be needing any of that, will you?
789.objectiveText: Get 10 Scorpid Worker Tails for Gornek in the Den.
789.progressText: The carapace of a scorpid isn't so thick that the strength of a determined warrior will be deterred. Strike strongly and without doubt, and the scorpids should prove easy prey.
789.title: Sting of the Scorpid

790.completionText: My blow was not enough to kill him, but looking at the damage I inflicted gives me some small measure of pride. That small measure will be all I have to sustain myself if I die, and in that light, the short list of my life's accomplishments fills me with anger.
790.description:
Hunter! I thought I would die out here with none to know of it. While I was hunting the scorpids of the Valley, I came across a particularly vicious-looking one. Hurling myself at it, I managed to inflict a massive blow to its claw before it closed around my leg.

I wasn't ready for its stinger though, and it sliced down and into my chest, cutting into my flesh and letting my blood. Please, you must kill the scorpid for me! My honor must be upheld! I fought it up on the plateau to the south.
790.objectiveText: Kill Sarkoth and bring his claw back to Hana'zua.
790.progressText:
Ahhh... my father always said I would never amount to much, and here, lying beneath a tree as life seeps away, I'm afraid it looks like he was right.

At least I wish to die knowing that my last enemy in life lays dead.
790.title: Sarkoth

792.completionText:
You have done well, <name>.

Although the Vile Familiars were merely pets of the darker powers within the Burning Blade, your success against them foretells greater deeds ahead.
792.description:
I trust the Valley of Trials will teach you much, young hunter.

I was sent to the Valley to guide you, but I have discovered a growing taint here...

A group that calls itself the Burning Blade has a coven here in the Valley of Trials.  They are skulking in a cave to the northeast, and their Vile Familiars have spilled from its mouth to cause havoc.

As your first task against the Burning Blade, I bid you, defeat these familiars. Slay many and, if you survive, return to me.
792.objectiveText:
Kill 12 Vile Familiars.

Return to Zureetha Fargaze outside the Den.
792.title: Vile Familiars

794.completionText:
You retrieved it!  Well done!

Your efforts within the Burning Blade Coven are key in rooting out this cult in the Valley of Trials.  But I fear they have further aims in our land.

We have not seen the end of them.
794.description:
Through my divinations, I see that an item of power hides deep within the Burning Blade Coven, guarded by beasts and black magic.

It is called the Burning Blade Medallion, and your next task is to find it and remove it from the coven.

But be wary, for the medallion may be possessed by an agent of the Burning Blade, and if so then the agent's power would be greater than the familiars you have already encountered.

Go, <name>.  You will find the coven in a cave, to the north and west.
794.objectiveText: Bring the Burning Blade Medallion to Zureetha Fargaze, outside The Den.
794.progressText: Is your task complete, <name>?  Do you have the Burning Blade Medallion?
794.title: Burning Blade Medallion

804.completionText:
From your description of the beast, I believe you must be speaking of Sarkoth! It is no wonder that Hana'zua was overtaken by it. Aid will be dispatched to him immediately, trouble yourself no more with Hana'zua's plight.

However, I must say, I am most impressed to hear that you brought Sarkoth to death. It is a feat to be proud of, <name>. And that you would fight for a stranger's honor, while other tasks occupied your time, your own honor is heightened.
804.description:
Seeing the deed you have done for me steels my heart. I cannot fall so easily! I must endure!

But it remains that I cannot make the trek back to the Den unassisted. Please, <name>, return to the Den and tell Gornek of my situation. Perhaps he can help me.
804.objectiveText: Bring the news of Hana'zua's plight to Gornek at the Den.
804.title: Sarkoth

805.completionText:
Hm... your report comes at a bad time.  The Burning Blade is not seen here in Sen'jin, but their evil has taken seed off the coast, on the Echo Isles.

The orcs are friends of the Darkspear Trolls.  Honorable friends.  We want to help the orcs, but... we need help too.
805.description:
Your trials against the Burning Blade are finished... here in the Valley.  But I want you to report your findings.

Go to the troll village of Sen'jin and seek out Master Gadrin.  Sen'jin Village is east out of the valley, then right at the fork.

Tell Gadrin of the Burning Blade, and that they have reached the Valley of Trials.  Discover from him if they have yet reached Sen'jin.

Go, <name>, and be swift.  I fear the evil found in the Burning Blade Coven is but the herald of a larger threat...
805.objectiveText: Speak with Master Gadrin in Sen'jin Village.
805.title: Report to Sen'jin Village

808.description:
I hear the voice of my brother, Minshina, calling to me in my dreams.

He was taken by Zalazane, the warlock on the Echo Isles to the east. And he is dead.

But death is not freedom for my brother. Minshina's spirit was trapped within his own skull by Zalazane's magics. In my dreams I see it with other skulls, in a circle of power on the largest Echo Isle. As long as it remains there my brother's soul is doomed.

Please, <name>. Find the circle and retrieve Minshina's skull. Bring it to me.

Free him!
808.objectiveText:
Retrieve Minshina's skull from the circle of power on the Echo Isles.

Bring it to Master Gadrin in Sen'jin Village.
808.title: Minshina's Skull

817.description:
Many of the hides we use come from Durotar tigers, <name>. Blankets, armor, tents: there are a great many reasons we hunt the beasts, and many reasons we let them thrive at the same time.

The time has come for us to cull the flock, so to speak. Our numbers grow, and our needs are beginning to overwhelm our stocks. I need more hides if I'm to prepare suitable goods for our people.

Bring me 4 Durotar tiger furs, and I shall reward you. You can find them on the islands south of here.
817.objectiveText: Bring 4 Durotar Tiger Furs to Vel'rin Fang in Sen'jin Village.
817.title: Practical Prey

818.description:
Although my eyes fail me, I still can see clearly enough. More often I must rely on my alchemical skills to aid me in magics that once came easily. But I refuse to take on an apprentice--no troll or orc worthy enough has ever come forward.

Are you worthy? Yes, of course you are... of course you think you are.

I need a few things. Will you get them for me?

I need intact makrura eyes, and vials of crawler mucus. You can find them on any makrura or crawler in Durotar. We shall speak again soon.
818.objectiveText: Bring 4 Intact Makrura Eyes and 8 vials of Crawler Mucus to Master Vornal in Sen'jin Village.
818.title: A Solvent Spirit

823.description:
We at Sen'jin Village are not without our own troubles, and we thank you for your aid.  But the news you bring regarding the Burning Blade could be trouble for everyone.

There is an orc stationed at Razor Hill, Orgnil Soulscar, who polices Durotar from evils such as the Burning Blade!  Go to Orgnil and tell him of our plight, as well as your news from the Valley of Trials.  He will want to know these things.

Razor Hill lies to the north.
823.objectiveText: Speak with Orgnil Soulscar in Razor Hill.
823.title: Report to Orgnil

826.description:
The witchdoctor Zalazane dwells on the Echo Isles to the east.  They are the isles we once called home.

From there he sends his trolls to the mainland, to hex our people and drag more of them under his sway.

He must be stopped.

Defeat Zalazane and his minions -- former Darkspear trolls, now lost to us.  Bring me his head and I will know his reign of evil is over.
826.objectiveText:
Defeat Zalazane.

Kill 8 Voodoo Trolls and 8 Hexed Trolls.

Bring Zalazane's Head to Gadrin.
826.title: Zalazane

833.description:
Only the most valiant tauren are laid to rest at Red Rocks, our sacred burial ground. It is an honor bestowed upon the great warriors who helped found and defend Thunder Bluff and those who have given their lives for the greater good of their tribes and chieftains.

But it appears a foul menace has made its way onto our holy land. A band of Bristleback Interlopers is ravaging the grave site and I am too old and past my prime to drive them away.

They must be driven off with force, <name>.
833.objectiveText: Lorekeeper Raintotem wants you to kill 8 Bristleback Interlopers at Red Rocks.
833.title: A Sacred Burial

854.description:
I have foreseen your arrival, young druid. Though perhaps you are not so young anymore.

I think that it is time for you to move deeper into this land. I can sense that you are destined for great things.

It is the Crossroads that you must seek out, for our lives with the orcs have become intertwined and they need assistance. Continue down this road towards the east and follow it north to the Crossroads. Find Thork within its walls, he has the Earthmother's blessing.
854.objectiveText: Speak with Thork at the Crossroads in the Barrens.
854.title: Journey to the Crossroads

861.description:
You are eager to explore, I can tell.  I too had the lust to wander, once...

Wander, and hunt.  For hunting is a Tauren's greatest honor.

If you truly wish to follow the ways of the hunter, then Melor Stonehoof can show you the path.  He is in Thunder Bluff, on the Hunter's Rise.

And to show him your skill and resolve, bring him the claws of the flatland prowlers of Mulgore.  They are tough and cunning -- fitting prey for a young druid on the hunter's path.
861.objectiveText: Bring 4 Flatland Prowler Claws to Melor Stonehoof in Thunder Bluff.
861.title: The Hunter's Way

886.description:
The druids of Thunder Bluff sense a strange power leaking into the Barrens, east of Mulgore.

Tonga Runetotem was sent to discover the source of this power, but we fear he will need aid.

Travel to the Barrens and speak with Tonga.  He will be at the Crossroads.  To reach there, take the road east out of Bloodhoof village.  Enter the Barrens, then turn north when the road forks.  Continue north and  you will find the Crossroads.

And do not leave the road, <name>, for the Barrens is a harsh land.
886.objectiveText: Speak with Tonga Runetotem at the Crossroads.
886.title: The Barrens Oases

95805.completionText: <As you empty the incense into the fire, the scent wafts around you, leaving you with just the empty pouch and a subtle sense of fulfillment.>
95805.description:
The sun and the moon, An'she and Mu'sha, are not part of our world like the elements, yet their light gives us life, guidance, and hope.

We pay respect to the spirits of the world, and so we pay respect to the twins as well.

If you would show your respect, take this smoldering incense and bring it to a shrine in the hills to the southeast, overlooking the mesa, south of the quilboar. Be quick, so that you can reach the shrine before the incense burns away.

Don't get it wet!
95805.objectiveText: Carry the Smoldering Incense to the shrine of An'she and Mu'sha in the southeastern hills before the incense burns to ash in ten minutes!

objectives.text: Carry the Smoldering Incense to the shrine of An'she and Mu'sha in the southeastern hills before the incense burns to ash in ten minutes!

95805.progressText: <The smoke from the incense rises toward the sky.>
95805.title: Grace of An'she and Mu'sha

96130.completionText: Taking the life of such a beautiful creature is a sad event, but it was necessary for the safety of our people. I will make certain that the pelt does not go to waste. Thank you.
96130.description:
Among the prairie wolves that hunt the hills nearby is one that is especially aggressive. We have taken to calling her Chakuyak. She has become a threat to travelers coming from abroad.

She stalks the trees west of Stonebull Lake, moving from tree stand to tree stand.

End this threat and bring me her pelt, and I will speak your praises to the chief. Beware, for she is dangerous! You might see other hunters seeking her out there, and perhaps you could work as a team.
96130.objectiveText: Defeat Chakuyak and bring back her pelt.
96130.progressText: Have you found the big wolf?
96130.title: Chakuyak

96605.completionText: So now that we've learned the basics, why don't you go and learn a tradeskill from the trainers in the village nearby. They will also teach you how to create a camp fixture suitable to your new profession.
96605.description:
Greetings, druid. I can see you've got the look of an adventurer about you. This is good. The world needs more of us restless souls, seeking fortune and glory.

You'll need to learn to thrive in the wilds to be successful in this line of work. Not sure how your outdoor skills are but I can probably teach you a thing or two, if you'd be apt to learn.

Have a seat near the fire and get comfortable. I'll walk you through it.
96605.objectiveText: Sit near Kaga's Basic Campfire and wait until you receive the Boosted Rest buff.
96605.progressText: Having the skills needed to survive the outdoors is critical. A well-rested and well-prepared adventurer has a much higher chance of surviving this lifestyle.
96605.title: The Great Outdoors

96652.description:
<The journal appears to be quite plain, detailing the life and adventures of someone you've never heard of.

There are multiple entries mentioning camping. It seems to be quite... fun.>
96652.objectiveText: Bring the journal to Brakk near Razor Hill.

objectives.text: Bring the journal to Brakk near Razor Hill.

96652.title: The Adventurer

96659.completionText:
Chief Hawkwind sent you? I told him back then I needed no compensation, but it seems he hasn't listened. Thank you, druid.

Hey, you've got the look of an adventurer yourself. How would you like to learn about camping?
96659.description:
Wait, <name>. I have another ask of you, before you leave us.

There is an adventurer by the name of Kaga Wildhoof who has made camp just outside of Bloodhoof Village. She has greatly helped me in the past, and now I see my chance to repay her. Could you deliver these supplies to her?
96659.objectiveText: Deliver the Supply Bundle to Kaga Wildhoof near Bloodhoof Village.

objectives.text: Deliver the Supply Bundle to Kaga Wildhoof near Bloodhoof Village.

96659.progressText: Are you here to learn about camping in the wilderness?
96659.title: The Adventurer

96661.completionText:
With this, you'll be able to set up a camp anywhere out in the wilderness. What you've learned is just the basics, so you won't be able to place too many furnishings around it.

Raise your cooking skill and you might just be able to learn to make even bigger fires.

You can also learn the basics of furnishing your campsites from other tradeskill trainers if you're savvy in their skills.
96661.description:
So you want to learn more about camping, huh? Good for you, druid. The first step any adventurer needs to take is to become a cook and learn how to make a campfire.

Cooking's not just about making tasty foods. It's also the foundation for your camp.
96661.objectiveText: Speak with Pyall Silentstride in Bloodhoof Village to learn to become a cook.

objectives.text: Learn cooking from Pyall Silentstride in Bloodhoof Village

96661.title: Camping 101: Cooking

96821.description:
We see fewer and fewer travelers from Razor Hill these days. The scorpids were never much fun, but now I hear there are spiders making their nest along the road.

If your travels take you up north, kill some of the spiders on your way. Then, let Razor Hill know the path's a bit safer for them.
96821.objectiveText: Kill 6 Ridgeshade Creepers and 6 Ridgeshade Lurkers in southern Durotar, then report to Gar'thok in Razor Hill.
96821.title: Legging It

97223.description:
All of the raptors you see before you are ones I have trained myself. They come from all over Kalimdor, but some of the finest come from the Bloodtalon raptors on the isles off our coast.

One raptor amongst them, the Bloodtalon Matriarch, is particularly savage and has killed many from our village and has become too dangerous to leave at our borders. If you can strike her down, return with her eggs so that we can raise the hatchlings as allies instead of enemies.
97223.objectiveText: Bring Eggs of the Bloodtalon Matriarch to Xar'Ti in Sen'jin Village.
97223.title: Bloodtalon Matriarch

97225.description:
When we fled the isles that Zalazane and his ilk now inhabit, we left behind many precious idols that help us commune with spirits we worship: our loa. They are of grave importance to our tribe.

The followers of Zalazane show no reverence for our loa and have scattered these idols across the largest of the isles.

This is an action that will not go unnoticed if we are not able to collect these idols, and offending a loa is a grave matter.

Go, find as many loa idols as you can and return them to me.
97225.objectiveText: Collect 8 Forgotten Loa Idols from the Echo Isles. Bring them to Master Gadrin in Sen'jin Village.
97225.title: Forgotten Loa Idols

97279.completionText: Thank you for returning these weapons, <name>. I will get to work repairing them for the next wave of recruits.
97279.description:
With an influx of new recruits like yourself, it's been hard to keep our weapons supplied. Our weaponsmith, Kzan, is running low on training weapons and I'd like to see what kinds of skills you possess to get an idea of what I have to work with. Luckily for you, I have a solution to both.

While you're out there cutting your teeth on boars, salvage six abandoned training weapons. Our failed recruits left them laying on the ground. Once you do, return them to our weaponsmith Kzan behind me in the Den.
97279.objectiveText: Collect 6 Abandoned Training Weapons, then return to Kzan Thornslash in the Den.
97279.progressText:
Throm'ka, hunter. Gorak told me I should be expecting you. It is good to see you in one piece!

Were you able to collect the training weapons I requested?
97279.title: Wayward Weapons

97485.description:
Blessings of An'she, child.

We have a tradition of scattering incense to the winds, and I was wondering if you'd be interested in honoring our tradition.

You will need to craft the incense by purchasing herbs from Nida, cedar from Nata, sinew thread from Mahu in the mid rise, and ceremonial flint and tinder from Naal on the upper rise. Once you have these items, combine them and spread them off the south facing cliff of Hunter's Rise.

You will find a mat and incense at the ceremonial site.
97485.objectiveText:
Purchase a Bundle of Herbs from Nida the herbalist, a Bundle of Cedar Twigs from Nata the enchanting supplier, and Sinew Thread from Mahu the leatherworking supplier and Ceremonial Flint and Tinder from Naal the cooking supplier.

Combine the items and sprinkle the incense off of Hunter's Rise.
97485.title: Traditions of the Bluff

97931.description:
So you've taken up First Aid? That's an honorable... and pragmatic pursuit as a druid.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a First Aid Kit for your camp. Injuries are a reality in the world of adventuring and offering some much-needed healing at your camp could even save lives.
97931.objectiveText: Speak with Vira Younghoof in Bloodhoof Village to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.

objectives.text: Raise your first aid skill to 20

97931.title: Camping 101: First Aid

97934.completionText:
There you have it, your very own camp tent. Most folk don't care much for tents being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.

Oh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.
97934.description:
You've become a leatherworker. Good for you, druid. I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to make yourself a tent that will keep you cool on hot days, and dry on rainy days.

With a good tent over your head, you'll ensure that you get all the rest you need to stay sharp on your travels.
97934.objectiveText: Speak with Chaw Stronghide in Bloodhoof Village to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
97934.title: Camping 101: Leatherworking

97936.completionText:
There you have it, you can now craft your very own Camp Chair. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.

Oh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.
97936.description:
Being able to skillfully harvest the skins and hides of fallen beasts is one of the more valuable skills an adventurer can possess.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Camp Chair for your camp. Sometimes it's important to just take a load off, and you can use some of those hides you've gathered to make a comfy chair to sit in. A bit of relaxation can help ensure that you are at your peak condition and can strike where it counts the next time you find yourself in a dust-up.
97936.objectiveText: Speak with Yonn Deepcut in Bloodhoof Village to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
97936.title: Camping 101: Skinning

98424.completionText:
Ah, this is most valuable knowledge. I thank you for your efforts.

<Morin looks through the notes.>

It seems our next move is clear.
98424.description:
Some particularly worn papers are held separately, folded in Fizsprocket's inside breast pocket.

They seem to detail important information that could be used against the Venture Co. and its operations in the region. It would be prudent to look for more before returning to Morin Cloudstalker.
98424.objectiveText: Collect the rest of Supervisor Fizsprocket's pages inside The Venture Co. Mine and bring them to Morin Cloudstalker near Bloodhoof Village.
98424.progressText: What is it you bring me, druid?
98424.title: Fizsprocket's Notes

98427.description:
The shredder one of the pages speaks of--I have seen them before in my travels. They can decimate a forest in a fraction of the time that hand and axe can.

Entire glades--homes to the Earth Mother's children for millennia--erased in days.

We will not allow this to happen in our home, a stone's throw from where our young ones take their first steps.

<name>, I must ask you to gather others, go back into the mine to the northeast, and ensure it fells not a single tree more.
98427.objectiveText: Bring the Clearcutter Key to Morin Cloudstalker outside Bloodhoof Village.
98427.title: Ceasing Operations

99079.completionText: It is clear that Malah did not die naturally. Arrows cover her back and the ground nearby.
99079.description:
The Longwalkers are our people's most trusted scouts. Though their loyalty lies with the High Chieftain alone, young Baine at times seeks their aid.

This is one such time. Longwalker Malah was dispatched near our borders to the east and did not return last night after three days. When this occurs, it is our duty to confirm their safety.

I must ensure the village remains safe. Prove yourself, and seek Malah out. You will know her by her headband and feathered staff, emblematic of the Longwalkers.
99079.objectiveText: Find Longwalker Malah Longwind east of Bloodhoof Village, near the edge of Mulgore.
99079.title: Longwalker Malah

99080.completionText:
You are covered in centaur blood. Remember this feeling. It is an honor unlike any other among our people.

I could hear the moment the last fell, and their thunderous stampede echoed no longer. Well done!

Today marks a great victory for our village, and a sense of security our young ones need now more than ever. You have my deepest thanks, young druid.
99080.description:
Hear my words well: we will not yield a single blade of grass to the centaur.

Go to their camp now, before they have rested and have a chance to ride to our village. Slaughter them all. Ensure none escape to the Barrens to rally others to their aid.

If you find the leader of this would-be raiding party, bring me his head so that it may serve as a warning to others who dare tread on our ancestral homeland.
99080.objectiveText: Kill 6 Galak Centaurs, 4 Galak Outrunners, and bring the head of Herak the Pillager to Baine Bloodhoof.
99080.title: Drive Them Out

99081.completionText: This is most dire news indeed. We must inform Baine at once!
99081.description:
You can see what appears to be a new centaur camp in the direction the arrows in Malah's back would have come from. There is a stir of activity, suggesting a small raiding party has made its way into Mulgore.

The Longwalker has a report in her still-clenched hand. Brave Wildrunner will want to know of Malah's fate--and her killers.
99081.objectiveText: Bring Longwalker Malah's Report to Brave Wildrunner in Bloodhoof Village.
99081.title: Grim Tidings

99082.completionText:
The Galak centaur dare show themselves in Mulgore?!

You have brought pride to your ancestors by driving them out. Perhaps that will remind them of the pain that awaits them should they do so again!

Please accept this gift in honor of this. May it serve you well as you venture out into the Earth Mother's kingdom, to the far reaches of this world.
99082.description:
Your bravery defending your people demands recognition. Journey to Thunder Bluff to the northwest, our mighty city whose shadow grants us shade in the warmer months, and seek audience with my father.

It was he who led the charge with the young Warchief Thrall to reclaim these plains and drive the centaur away for good. As High Chieftain, he will reward you generously for your part in ensuring his own bravery is honored.

You must take a lift to reach the High Chieftain, who sits on the central rise.
99082.objectiveText: Seek audience with High Chieftain Cairne Bloodhoof in Thunder Bluff.
99082.title: The High Chieftain

99101.completionText:
<Baine reads the report, his gaze darkening.>

This will not stand. Thank you for delivering it to me, <name>.
99101.description:
Baine Bloodhoof leads our village. He must know of this incursion at once.

Bring him Longwalker Malah's report. You will find him at the center of town.

Quickly, now. There is no time to waste!
99101.objectiveText: Bring Longwalker Malah's Report to Baine Bloodhoof.

objectives.text: Bring Longwalker Malah's Report to Baine Bloodhoof.

99101.progressText: What is it you bring me, druid?
99101.title: Our Ancient Enemy

99108.completionText:
You honor me with your abilities, druid. Perhaps the new generation has hope yet.

Take these to tend to your wounds, for many more battles await you in this harsh world.
99108.description:
Hail, young druid. Though you are not a warrior and I cannot teach you that path, that does not mean you would not benefit from my tutelage.

Before you lies the arena. In it, it matters not who you call mother or whether you wield sword or bow. All are equal, and all learn to sharpen their horns in direct combat.

Will you enter our space, and learn our ways for yourself? You may face any of these novices, or any other willing adversary. I care not which.
99108.objectiveText: Defeat 3 other players in duels or Novice Warriors for Tang Stonehoof.

objectives.text: Player Duels won or Novice Warriors defeated

99108.title: Sparring Match

99411.completionText: Fantastic work, <name>! Kyle came home as soon as he ate and went straight to bed. Thank you for your help.
99411.description:
Help, <name>! My prized puppy, Kyle, has run away! I just know he's running around Bloodhoof Village, lost and hungry.

Will you find him and feed him? Once he eats he will settle down and come home.

To feed him you will need to find food. His favorite meal is tender strider meat. Just venture east and you should find plenty of striders. Hunt one down and take its succulent meat to Kyle. When you see Kyle in town, put the meat down and he is sure to come to you.
99411.objectiveText:
Ahab Wheathoof at Bloodhoof Village in Mulgore wants you to feed his prized puppy, Kyle the Frenzied.

Feed Kyle Tender Strider Meat and return to Ahab Wheathoof.
99411.title: Kyle's Gone Missing!
